scope: Planck spectral-shape proxy assigned to each saved grey escape increment at outer-cell temperature; not a predicted escaping spectrum. No new hydro, radiation transport, or lifetime inference.
temperature_scope: A/B2/C13 weighted kT13--16keV; B1 is softer. Bin-endpoint variants are sampling checks; temperature factors are model sensitivities, not confidence intervals.
energy_scope: mu_en/rho bulk energy-transfer proxy with mixture mass additivity. Local retention factor is an independent unknown; this does not simulate secondary electrons, incident plasma electrons, sheath return, or photon multiple scattering. All-interaction energy is a looser bound for each single crossing.
